label: prose:intro-structure-to-numbers
html:
The route from the axioms to a number that can be compared with experiment passes through a short sequence of steps, each of them a standard construction applied to the structure above. They are stated here in words; the mass-analysis chapter records each step with its algorithm (derivation chain).

  1. From processes to braids. A configuration of strands followed through the internal time-flow traces out a braid, and composing processes composes braids. The braiding of the category therefore gives a representation of the braid group, and integrating it over surfaces lands in the Iwahori–Hecke algebra H_n(q).

  2. From braids to knots. Joining the ends of a braid closes it into a knot or link. A theorem of Jones and Ocneanu gives a unique normalised trace on H_n(q) compatible with closing, the Markov trace \mathrm{tr}_M, and evaluated on a closed braid it is the Jones polynomial J_K(q) (Markov trace). Each knot thus receives a rational function of q.

  3. From one trace to finitely many pieces. The algebra H_n(q) splits into matrix blocks indexed by the partitions \lambda of n, exactly as \mathbb{C}[S_n] does at q = 1. On each block the trace is an ordinary matrix trace, the character \chi_\lambda, so the Markov trace becomes a finite weighted sum \mathrm{tr}_M = \sum_\lambda y_\lambda \chi_\lambda — the Fourier decomposition of the trace over the irreducible blocks (Wedderburn decomposition).

  4. From many candidates to one element. Which element of the algebra represents a given composite is not chosen by hand. Candidates are built by pair production from photons, and a semidefinite program over the Frobenius pairing selects among them; its dual variables record which blocks the selected state saturates (confinement program). Where this selection is complete and where it is still open is recorded composite by composite in the nuclear and mass chapters.

  5. From rational functions to numbers. Everything up to this point is algebra in the variable q. The last step is the archimedean realisation: substitute the measured value q_0 and multiply by a single unit of scale (archimedean functor).

The order matters. The categorical steps fix shapes — which knots, which blocks, which weights — without reference to any measurement; the measured world enters only at step five, in the three numbers described next.
